description: Tráfico Aéreo is a dataset listed in Chilean national open data portal (datos.gob.cl), an open data portal, published or maintained by Junta de Aeronáutica Civil. En este conjunto de datos se cargan las estadísticas históricas de tráfico aéreo nacional e internacional con relación a Chile, en tres set de datos distintos: 1. Tráfico Aéreo Mensual (2022 a la actualidad) 2. Tráfico Aéreo Mensual Histórico1984-2025 3. Oferta y Demanda (KPI Industria Aérea) Las fuentes de información son: 1. Coverage: Junta de Aeronáutica Civil. The portal files it under the publisher Junta de Aeronáutica Civil. Its tags are aerolineas, aviacion, transporte. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-21 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-cl-portal.
